description: Reading an unbound mixed-case `:SomeVar` raises `ol-undefined-var` whose `params.name` is the case-insensitive resolution identity `somevar`, NOT the source casing — so the runtime guard agrees with the semantic checker's folded `params.name` for the same condition (issue #1005). Variable resolution folds case (`lookupVar`), so one condition must have one diagnostic identity (`spec/error-model.md:255-260`). Issue #815: `execute()` now runs Layer 1 and Layer 2 before Phase 2 and refuses a program carrying an `error`-severity finding (`spec/execution-model.md:659-664`), so no event is emitted and the diagnostic delivered here is the CHECK's. The runtime's own copy of the rule still exists and still runs — under the `runUnchecked` opt-out — and is collapsed into the check's by the de-duplication rule (`spec/execution-model.md:741-748`), which is why only one report survives and it reads `stage: "semantic"`.
